description: Maintenance and repairs at Ooma Creek Bridge, North West of Grenfell: review of environmental factors is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The proposal is to carry out maintenance and repairs at Ooma Creek Bridge, approximately 10km north-west of Grenfell. The aim is to remediate severe gully erosion by constructing a rock ramp on the down stream side of the bridge. Note: This resource was originally published on opengov.nsw.gov.au. The OpenGov website has been retired. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales, bridge, grenfell, ooma creek bridge. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
